openclaw-aligenie-push v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for pushing proactive messages to Tmall Genie devices.
- Supports message broadcasting via commands or async Python function calls.
- Customizable parameters for text content, device type, and target device.
- Includes setup and configuration guide for Tmall Genie integration and server deployment.
